statement: Let freq(v) be the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(arr) and arr[i] = v. The function returns a result r, and: r = -1 if and only if there is no integer v with 1 <= v and freq(v) = v; if r != -1 then freq(r) = r and for every integer v with 1 <= v and freq(v) = v, v <= r.
preconditions: 1 <= len(arr) <= 500; for every i with 0 <= i < len(arr), 1 <= arr[i] <= 500.

statement: For every slice arr satisfying the preconditions, the function returns a result r; it does not fail due to overflow, out-of-bounds access, or panic.
preconditions: 1 <= len(arr) <= 500; for every i with 0 <= i < len(arr), 1 <= arr[i] <= 500.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, either r = -1 or 1 <= r <= len(arr).
preconditions: 1 <= len(arr) <= 500; for every i with 0 <= i < len(arr), 1 <= arr[i] <= 500.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r with r != -1, freq(r) = r, where freq(v) is the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(arr) and arr[i] = v.
preconditions: 1 <= len(arr) <= 500; for every i with 0 <= i < len(arr), 1 <= arr[i] <= 500.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, for every integer v with v >= 1 and v > r, freq(v) != v, where freq(v) is the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(arr) and arr[i] = v.
preconditions: 1 <= len(arr) <= 500; for every i with 0 <= i < len(arr), 1 <= arr[i] <= 500.

statement: If for every integer v with 1 <= v, freq(v) != v, then the function returns a result r with r = -1, where freq(v) is the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(arr) and arr[i] = v.
preconditions: 1 <= len(arr) <= 500; for every i with 0 <= i < len(arr), 1 <= arr[i] <= 500.

statement: If there exists an integer v with 1 <= v and freq(v) = v, then the function returns a result r with r != -1, where freq(v) is the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(arr) and arr[i] = v.
preconditions: 1 <= len(arr) <= 500; for every i with 0 <= i < len(arr), 1 <= arr[i] <= 500.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r with r != -1, there exists an index i with 0 <= i < len(arr) and arr[i] = r.
preconditions: 1 <= len(arr) <= 500; for every i with 0 <= i < len(arr), 1 <= arr[i] <= 500.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r with r != -1, r <= max(arr), where max(arr) is the largest element of arr (well-defined since len(arr) >= 1).
preconditions: 1 <= len(arr) <= 500; for every i with 0 <= i < len(arr), 1 <= arr[i] <= 500.

statement: For every slice arr' with len(arr') = len(arr) and for every integer v, freq_{arr'}(v) = freq_arr(v) (where freq_X(v) is the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(X) and X[i] = v), the function returns the same result on arr' as on arr: if the function returns r on arr, then it returns r on arr'.
preconditions: 1 <= len(arr) <= 500; for every i with 0 <= i < len(arr), 1 <= arr[i] <= 500. Let arr' be any slice with len(arr') = len(arr) and with the same frequency function as arr, i.e. for every integer v the number of occurrences of v in arr' equals that in arr.
